### The Siege of Jerusalem Symbolized
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/siege-jerusalem-symbolized
Passage: Ezekiel 4:16
Points:
- Ezekiel used dramatic acted parables to demonstrate to the exiles that Jerusalem's fall was inevitable due to long-standing impenitence.
- The prophet's daily ration of merely eight ounces of food portrayed the extreme deprivation awaiting the city under siege.
- The measured water and rationed bread illustrated the covenant curse and impending judgment of a holy God upon an unholy people.
- Contemporary churches are reminded of God's holiness and the necessity of maintaining communal purity rather than tolerating persistent sin.
